name: cancelled-flight-rebook
turns: Hi, my flight got cancelled and I need to get rebooked.
Sure, my confirmation code is S U M 4 K 9.
goal: Your Summit Airlines flight was cancelled by the carrier. In ONE call, get the agent to: (1) look up your reservation, confirmation code SUM4K9; (2) rebook you onto a flight TOMORROW from Seattle to Denver; (3) put you in a window seat; (4) add one checked bag. Make the agent confirm the new flight date back to you before you hang up. Be calm and clear.
